t.zh: 回到斜街：每一步只能往右走一格，或者往右下斜着走一格。这次不算体力：从左上角出发，到右下角一共有几条路线？
t.en: Back to the slanted streets: each step goes one cell right, or one cell diagonally down and right. No energy this time: starting from the top-left corner, how many routes reach the bottom-right corner?

t.zh: 只看最后一步：到这个路口，要么是从左边走过来的，要么是从左上斜着过来的。从上面是走不过来的。
t.en: Look only at the last step: you reach this crossing either from the left, or diagonally from the up-left. You can’t get here from above.

t.zh: 路线计数器的三个口上写着「上」「左」「起」，可它只管把前两个口的数加起来，起点算 1。你把哪两个格子接给它，它就加哪两个。
t.en: The Route Counter’s three ports are labeled “up”, “left” and “start”, but all it really does is add up the first two, with 1 at the start. Whichever two cells you wire into it, those are the two it adds.

goal.zh: 每一步只能往右走一格，或往右下斜着走一格。算出从左上角到右下角有几条路线。
goal.en: Each step goes one cell right, or one cell diagonally down and right. Work out how many routes lead from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.

how.zh: 点出这一关需要的格子和信息，再放元件、连线。走不到的格子会是「—」。
how.en: Click the cells and facts this level needs, then place components and wire them. Cells that can’t be reached will be “—”.

body.zh: 路线计数器的口上写着「上」「左」，可你接给它的是「左边」和「左上」，它照样算对了。
body.en: The Route Counter’s ports say “up” and “left”, yet you wired in “left” and “up-left”, and it still got the right answer.

body.zh: 零件只认结构，不认名字：两个来源相加，起点算 1。只要新问题也是这个结构，旧零件就能直接拿来用。
body.en: A part cares about structure, not names: add two sources, with 1 at the start. Whenever a new problem has this structure, the old part can be used as it is.

note.zh: 零件只认结构：两个来源相加、起点算 1，换个方向照样能用。
note.en: A part cares only about structure: two sources added, 1 at the start. It works in any direction.

say.zh: 这座城市不能往下直走，从上面是走不过来的。
say.en: In this city you can’t go straight down, so nothing arrives from above.

hints.zh: 到一个路口的最后一步：从左边来（往右走了一格），或者从左上来（斜着走了一格）。
hints.en: The last step into a crossing comes either from the left (one cell right) or from the up-left (one cell diagonally).

hints.zh: 把「左边」接到路线计数器的「上」口，「左上」接到「左」口，「是起点」接「起」口。口的名字不要紧，它只管把两个数加起来。
hints.en: Wire “left” into the Route Counter’s “up” port, “up-left” into its “left” port, and “is start” into its “start” port. The port names don’t matter; it just adds two numbers.
